description: This file contains unit tests for the OfflineFirstTopicsRepository class, verifying its behavior in syncing topics data between local storage and network sources, including incremental updates and deletions.

classes.name: OfflineFirstTopicsRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for OfflineFirstTopicsRepository, testing synchronization, incremental updates, and deletion handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating mock/fake instances of dependencies.

methods.name: offlineFirstTopicsRepository_topics_stream_is_backed_by_topics_dao
methods.description: Verifies that the topics stream from the repository reflects data from the local DAO.

methods.name: offlineFirstTopicsRepository_sync_pulls_from_network
methods.description: Tests that syncing pulls the latest topics from the network and updates the local database.

methods.name: offlineFirstTopicsRepository_incremental_sync_pulls_from_network
methods.description: Verifies incremental sync behavior when local version is behind the network; only new items are fetched.

methods.name: offlineFirstTopicsRepository_sync_deletes_items_marked_deleted_on_network
methods.description: Checks that items marked deleted on the network are also removed locally after sync.
